title: Scalar tensor comparisons respect arbitrary pullback squares
statement: For an arbitrary homomorphism φ:A→B of commutative rings and a chosen Cartesian square (h,f′,f,g), let S be canonical derived scalar extension [def-sp-constant-scalar-pullback-comparison], let λ be the specified tensor/inverse-image comparisons [def-weil-pbc-four-corners], and let c_R be the exact localization of the normalized ordinary square compositor moduleSquareG for the ring R [lem-fix-constant-square-compositor-specification]. For each N∈D(Y,A), the inverse-comparison equality is S_X′(c_A.inv_N) followed by λ_f′.inv_(g_A*N) and f′_B*(λ_g.inv_N), equals λ_h.inv_(f_A*N) followed by h_B*(λ_f.inv_N) and c_B.inv_(S_Y N). Thus the scalar comparisons respect c. No open-immersion, finiteness or flatness hypotheses are needed.

proof.text: Restriction/direct-image comparison is identity on sections, and moduleRComp is restriction along Over.pullbackComp. These section formulas give the direct-image composition square. Conjugation, mate pasting and equality transport give its ordinary restriction/pullback form for the two paths of sq.w.

The generic exact-derived composition associativity and whiskering identities identify the localization of the two ordinary cube pastings. Cancel the common triple-composition comparison, then evaluate at an arbitrary derived object. This transports the ordinary restriction cube without geometric assumptions.

Use the four scalar extension/restriction adjunctions. Injectivity of the final Hom equivalence, the mate-unit equations and naturality turn the derived restriction cube into the left-mate cube. The definition of proEtaleReductionPullbackIso identifies these mates with the required inverse scalar comparisons.

theorem scalarTensorPullbackSquare {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B)
    {U' U X' X : Scheme.{u}}
    (gU : U' ⟶ U) (j' : U' ⟶ X') (j : U ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare gU j' j g)
    (N : DerivedCategory (Scheme.proEtaleRingModules X (CR X A))) :
    let S (T : Scheme.{u}) := directImageScalarExtension φ T
    let c (R : Type u) [CommRing R] := Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
      (StrictTower.moduleSquareG (ULift.{u + 1, u} R) gU j' j g sq.toCommSq.w)
    let lam {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) := directImageScalarPullbackIso φ f
    (S U').map ((c A).inv.app N) ≫
      (lam j').inv.app ((PB A g).obj N) ≫ (PB B j').map ((lam g).inv.app N) =
    (lam gU).inv.app ((PB A j).obj N) ≫
      (PB B gU).map ((lam j).inv.app N) ≫ (c B).inv.app ((S X).obj N)
